, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misstated Luis César Amadori’s death year as 1997 instead of the correct 1977, despite WebSurfer having surfaced 1977 earlier. Using 1997 would incorrectly make Good Morning, Little Countess appear to have the director who died later, whereas Raymond Rouleau (Vogue la galère) actually died later in 1981.
